title: Harbor Adapters与Harbor-Index：大规模智能体评估的基础设施与精选元数据集
summary: 本文提出Harbor Adapters统一评估基础设施，将80多个基准适配为任意智能体可评估，并验证其可靠性。通过大规模评估8个模型、54个基准，引入Harbor-Index精选82个高质量任务，保持挑战性且成本可控，最强配置通过率仅28%。开源适配器、结果与分析，促进更可靠的智能体评估。
summary_en: Introduces Harbor Adapters, a unified infrastructure porting 80+ benchmarks for agent evaluation, and Harbor-Index, a curated set of 82 tasks from 29 benchmarks. Large-scale evaluation of 8 models shows no config exceeds 30% pass rate. Open-source artifacts support reliable agentic evaluation.
